adaptation: A small logger with an unbounded list replaces YOLOX MeterBuffer/AverageMeter. No optimizer or backward is executed. This is not a faithful reproduction of the original training bug.
fixed_control: detach at sink; output payload may still grow; graph-associated excess must be removed
source_evidence: YOLOX maintainers identify logging attached loss tensors among memory issues; commit d894530 adds detach before meter updates.
classification_scope: Runtime-confirmed in this small reproducer; original project not executed
title: Cross-method metric logger
mechanism: metric tensor stored by logger method

dimensions.flow_scope: cross-method: run loop to logger method
dimensions.lifetime: logger object retained in run state
dimensions.cleanup: logger released after workload; no per-iteration cleanup
